parsed.headline: Claim sent for review due to missing BGM testing frequency documentation.
parsed.explanation: The record does not show whether the beneficiary has been using a BGM and performing frequent (four or more times a day) testing, as required by: "The beneficiary has been using a BGM and performing frequent (four or more times a day) testing; and,". A person will review the claim to determine if this requirement is met.
parsed.what_to_do: Submit documentation showing the beneficiary's BGM testing frequency if available.
